scope: Sustained visual testing of ordinary structures and common combinations; finite coverage, not a claim that every possible bug is absent.

requirements.requirement: Sustained testing for hours on ordinary small structures
requirements.result: 8880 completed workflow steps and 7764.885 seconds across successful baseline chains; continuation completed.

requirements.requirement: Rotate, zoom, pan and change window/display state
requirements.result: Performed actions recorded in completed candidate run; representative rendered results directly inspected.

requirements.requirement: Selection and measurement combined with atom, boundary and frame editing
requirements.result: Wide/narrow visual boundary editing and sustained measurement edit chains passed; actual distance, periodic selection, marker picking and drag behavior pass in updated main app.

requirements.requirement: Sidebar resize/collapse, file changes and undo/redo
requirements.result: Performed varied actions, directly inspected representative UI, and main-app regressions passed.

requirements.requirement: Reproduce and fix common visual defects
requirements.result: Four reproduced defects fixed: label depth, point marker overlap/wrong picking, coordinate clipping, constraint value clipping. All seven focused DPR2 checks pass.
22 browser checks and 154 unit tests pass. Main app serves v183 and CSS v54 with no page errors; screenshot inspected.

requirements.requirement: Save locally without pushes, new buttons or modifying existing unsaved browser tab
requirements.evidence: Local commit 4ecc8a0, scoped app/CSS/index/test diff and tool action history
requirements.result: Fixes committed locally. Only isolated headless browser contexts used; original IAB tab untouched. No remote push or new button added.

knownLimitation: Synthetic 499-atom continuous-playback stress test exceeds its 240-second capture deadline. Outside requested ordinary small-structure scope; full broader suite is not reported as all green.
